record.question: With reference to the initiatives concerning Mizoram in the Union Budget 2026–27 presented by the Ministry of Finance, consider the following statements: I. The budget emphasises decentralised renewable energy and small hydropower potential in hilly and border states to enhance regional energy security. II. Special attention has been given to improving connectivity and rural infrastructure to integrate remote habitations with national economic corridors. III. The budget proposes the replacement of shifting cultivation (jhum) with compulsory commercial plantation through a centrally mandated law. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
